findings.title: the ENTRY_LIMIT sweep missed one unbounded read in the same function
findings.reason: The archivedPeriods query selects EVERY location_archived/location_reactivated row for a location from account_audit_log with no LIMIT and no SQL window predicate, then filters to the window in TypeScript. Row volume is driven by operator archive/reactivate actions rather than tenant data, so the practical risk is low — but it is the one sibling of the “neither arm was bounded” fix that was not swept.
